name: Captain Altair

abilities.name: Off-Hand Strike
abilities.description: A physical attack dealing minor damage. If it hits in the back, it also staggers and applies a bleeding effect. They always use this attack when they reappear behind from using their salt abilities.

abilities.name: Lunge
abilities.description: When far, the swashbuckler charges the target, dealing damage and staggering it.

abilities.name: Void Salt Explosion
abilities.description: The enemy throws down void salts, causing an explosion and setting down a gout of lightning, indicated by a circular AoE, that deals damage over time when you stand in it. The initial blast does lightning damage. The enemy disappears and cannot be targeted while the ability is active.

abilities.name: Burning Void Salts
abilities.description: The pool of lightning caused by Void Salt Explosion. Deals lightning damage over time.

abilities.name: Somersault
abilities.description: The enemy somersaults backwards to put distance between you and them.

abilities.name: Boulder Toss/Debris Toss
abilities.description: Captain Altair grabs a large rock on the ground and tosses it on a target, dealing moderate damage and knocking down targets in the area of impact.

abilities.name: Vomit
abilities.description: Captain Altair breathes fire in a cone which deals continuous disease damage to targets inside.

dialogue.speaker: Vanisande Maul
dialogue.line: There's lingering doubt about this book. Regrets are a lost soul's anchor.
<A vision of Commodore Malfairre standing before Captain Fauvette, Captain Tuvacca and Captain Altair.>
<While he is in the scene, he does not say anything.>

dialogue.speaker: Vanisande Maul
dialogue.line: I can feel the dread clinging to this one.
dialogue.trigger: After reading Dour Lady's Captain Log

dialogue.line: <A vision of Captain Altair and Captain Tuvacca talking will appear.>
dialogue.trigger: After reading Dour Lady's Captain Log

dialogue.speaker: Captain Altair
dialogue.line: The Commodore keeps those old idols as good luck charms, but you have to wonder whose favor he's attracting.
dialogue.trigger: After reading Dour Lady's Captain Log

dialogue.speaker: Captain Tuvacca
dialogue.line: Aye, and he claims that crusty old tome keeps the secrets of the seas. Why aren't we all bending knee to druids then?
dialogue.trigger: After reading Dour Lady's Captain Log

summary: Captain Altair is the spirit of a Breton ship captain in Ghost Haven Bay. He acts as one of the bosses in the public dungeon.
